description: This file defines an Android Activity class 'MyRssReader2' that loads, displays, and manages an RSS feed list, with UI components, menu handling, and custom list adapter implementation.

classes.name: MyRssReader2
classes.description: An Android Activity for reading RSS feeds, managing list view, and handling user interactions.

classes.name: MyRssReader2.RssDataAdapter
classes.description: A custom ArrayAdapter to display RSS items with custom formatting based on read status.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets content view, prepares RSS list, and restores previous state.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves the current list selection state.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Creates options menu with actions like start, stop, add, delete, and update feeds.

methods.name: onPrepareOptionsMenu
methods.description: Prepares the options menu; can be used to toggle menu items.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selection and shows corresponding alerts.

methods.name: initializeList
methods.description: Creates and returns a sample list of RSS feed items.
